messages.author: ef564d903de9fe71
messages.subject: Modeling 3d spatial data
parts:
Hello,

I'm going to use spde-inla methodology for analyzing a large spatial data set.
The spatial domain in this data set is 3 dimensional (latitude, longitude and altitude). 
We have a large sample size for observations as well as for non-observed locations; something large than 4 millions of locations.

Is it possible to use spde-inla to fit a model and predict for 3d spatial data? Is there any reference work or example?

Also, I need to use a multivariate (perhaps bi-variate) spatial model. I would appreciate if one could share some info to modeling multivariate responses with spde-inla as well.

Thanks in advance and all the best,
Hossein

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Modeling 3d spatial data
parts:
Hi,

3D spde models is currently not supported, but I guess Finn is the
right one here... I don't know if anyone have done this.

what kind of multivariate response do you have? Normal?

H
